0022600094.text: The Atlanta Hawks (1-0, 1st in the Southeast and 2nd in the East) visit the Charlotte Hornets (1-0, 3rd in the Southeast and 6th in the East) in the Hawks' second game of the season, with both teams on a one-game winning streak. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), both out, while Charlotte is missing Kylan Boswell (knee, out) and has Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (hamstring) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not played each other yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Hawks lost 1-3 to the Hornets in 2025-26, including a 110-107 defeat in Charlotte on February 11, 2026.
